title: With -fno-avx, the compiler stops on x *. Array.unsafe_get a i
summary: With `-fno-avx` (also `-fno-sse3`, `-fno-ssse3`, `-fno-sse41`, `-fno-sse42`) the compiler stops on `x *. Array.unsafe_get a i` with "Exception whilst emitting instruction" and `Invalid_argument("index out of bounds")`.

actual.text: The compiler stops with `Exception whilst emitting instruction` and `Fatal error: exception Invalid_argument("index out of bounds")`, exit status 2.

cause: `backend/amd64/cfg_selection.ml`, `pseudoregs_for_operation`: with two-operand float instructions, the arguments of `Ifloatarithmem` lose the index register of the address.
